### Flourishing - God's Love at Work - Week of August 25
Author: A Woman's Walk
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/a-womans-walk/a-womans-walk-week-of-aug-29-11608022.html
Passage: Psalm 52:8
Points:
- Flourishing like a green olive tree comes from resting in God's unfailing love rather than our own self-righteousness.
- Believers are nurtured to bear spiritual fruit that blesses others when they remain connected to God's presence.
- Like an olive tree that thrives across centuries and changing seasons, a life rooted in God endures through trials.
- Relying on human strength leads to spiritual drought, while repentance restores us to fruitful life in God.
- God designs and desires for His children to walk in wisdom and flourish continually.
